svg.title: Labyrinth exploration
svg.desc: A maze in which the explored part is charted in blue, refuted dead ends are hatched in rust, open doors at the edge of the map are gold, hunches in the dark are dashed pink circles, and the rest of the maze is grey fog.
svg.text: Research as mapping a labyrinth: what is
proved, what is walled off, which doors
are open, and where it is still dark.
